instruction: Keep people and pets out of Deer Creek between Broad St and Champion Mine Rd.
attribution: Data: California State Water Resources Control Board (mock)
source_name: CA Water Boards (CIWQS) sewage spill report
title: Sewage spill reported near Deer Creek
summary: About 1,200 gallons of sewage reached a storm drain that flows to Deer Creek below Nevada City. Avoid contact with the water downstream until the county says it is clear.

instruction: Do not let dogs drink or swim in green or scummy water.
title: Algal bloom watch: Wolf Creek
summary: Lots of algae was reported this week and air temperature is 80 °F or more. Keep dogs out of slow, green water.

area.area_desc: Wolf Creek, Allison Ranch Rd area

instruction: Do not let pets swim in or drink the water. Rinse off after contact.
title: Caution advisory: Scotts Flat Reservoir
summary: A harmful algal bloom may be present. Avoid algae and scum in the water and keep pets away.

area.area_desc: Scotts Flat Reservoir (upstream of Deer Creek)

instruction: Drink plenty of water and stay out of the sun during the afternoon.
title: Heat Advisory
summary: Afternoon highs near 100 °F in the foothills. Warm, slow water helps algae grow; check on pets near creeks.

attribution: Sierra Streams Institute volunteer monitoring, via RiverDB (mock)
title: High E. coli at Pioneer Park
summary: A volunteer test found E. coli at 410 per 100 mL, above the 320 swim limit. Avoid swallowing the water.

area.area_desc: Little Deer Creek at Pioneer Park

title: Low flow on Deer Creek
summary: Deer Creek is flowing at about 4.8 cubic feet per second, low but normal for early October.
